# Process

## Ranked Failure Clusters
1. Range Bleed / Over-modification (395-36, 50768, 267-18) [STRUCTURE] - High Leverage
2. Type Coercion (402-43, 31628) [KNOWLEDGE] - Medium Leverage
3. Logic/Calculation Errors (227-40, 37456, 43436) [STRUCTURE] - Medium Leverage

## Kept Edits
- prompt.md: Strengthened "Precision & Minimal Change" to explicitly forbid modifying untouched cells. Lever: Rewrite for clarity.
- prompt.md: Added rule to "Typed Values" to forbid converting text to numbers/dates unless asked. Lever: Add a rule.
- task_template.md: Expanded "Mandatory Verification" to include checking against original values and printing (row, col, value). Lever: Tighten output contract.
- prompt.md: Clarified Excel date serial calculation (1900-01-01 = 1). Lever: Knowledge gap.

## Verification
- 395-36, 50768, 267-18: The updated "Precision & Minimal Change" rule explicitly forbids modifications of cells that already contain the correct value and mandates leaving them untouched.
- 402-43: The new "Typed Values" rule forbids converting text to numbers, which directly addresses the "KEEP the original text" feedback.
- 31628: The clarification on the Excel epoch (1900-01-01 = 1) provides a more reliable base for serial date calculation than the previously used 1899-12-30.
- 227-40, 37456, 43436: The expanded verification step forces the agent to print (row, col, value) and compare against original values, making logic errors more visible before the final save.

## Blast Radius
- All edits are additive or clarifications of existing constraints.
- Passing tasks (e.g., 51-12, 80-42) already follow these constraints (minimal change, correct types, verification), so their behavior will not change.
- Class: BOUNDED.

## Subagents/Features Used
- None. All diagnosis and editing performed inline.
